name: kpot
description: Turns a chaotic home photo/video collection into a chronological library: scans, dates by metadata, groups duplicates, sorts into year/season folders — with a dry run, a backup commit and rollback.
author: Mikalai Kryvusha (KOT KRINIK)
//files: What a user installing KPOT actually needs. Without this npm packs the WHOLE repo — the release rehearsal for 0.1 produced a 17 MB tarball carrying the .psd logo source, the KAIF framework and every internal working document. npm adds package.json/README/LICENSE by itself.
